es.title: Cuestionario de bienestar (muestra)
items: Me ha costado disfrutar de cosas que antes me gustaban.
Me he sentido desanimada o sin ánimo.
He dormido mal o he tenido dificultad para dormir.
Me he sentido cansada o con poca energía.
He comido mucho o muy poco sin querer.
Me he sentido mal conmigo misma o como si fuera un fracaso.
Me ha costado concentrarme en lo que hago.
Me he movido o hablado más despacio de lo normal, o al contrario, muy inquieta.
He pensado que sería mejor no estar viva o en hacerme daño.
options: Más de la mitad de los días

en.title: Wellbeing questionnaire (sample)
items: I have found it hard to enjoy things I used to like.
I have felt down or without energy.
I have slept badly or had trouble sleeping.
I have felt tired or had little energy.
I have eaten much more or much less than usual.
I have felt bad about myself or like a failure.
I have found it hard to concentrate on what I am doing.
I have moved or spoken more slowly than usual, or the opposite, felt very restless.
I have thought it would be better not to be alive or to hurt myself.
